answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation using four annotators across 50 test samples... specifically, given an explanation, all annotators are asked to answer five questions (Q1-Q5) that aimed at evaluating the usefulness of LACOAT. Q1 evaluates whether LACOAT attributes the correct concept to a given prediction, while Q2 and Q3 measure the efficacy of LACOAT's output in helping a user understand the prediction. Q4 and Q5 evaluates the output of PlausiFyer.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered five predefined questions (Q1–Q5) about the explanation, covering relation to the input, helpfulness for understanding the prediction, helpfulness of the explanation, accuracy of the description, and relevance to the task.
